name: aster
description: Framework-agnostic icon definitions, curated collections, and rendering adapters.
author: BlueLuscious

scripts.benchmark:core: pnpm --filter @aster/core run build && pnpm --filter @aster/icons run build && node --expose-gc tooling/performance/core/core-baseline.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:architecture && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.check:types: pnpm run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run check:types
scripts.test: pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm --recursive --if-present run test && pnpm run test:workflow
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
